places.name: The Great Wall of China (Mutianyu Section)
places.ai_summary: The Mutianyu section of the Great Wall combines well-preserved wall architecture with dramatic mountain scenery and fewer crowds than Badaling.

opening_hours.notes: Cable car and toboggan services may operate on seasonal schedules.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to avoid afternoon tour buses and take the cable car up to save time.

attribution.title: China-Grosse Mauer-118-Bogen-2012-gje

places.name: Forbidden City (Palace Museum)
places.ai_summary: The Forbidden City is the imperial palace complex at the center of Beijing, housing extensive collections of Chinese art and cultural artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on certain public holidays; timed-entry tickets used during peak season.

places.place_tip: Buy tickets online with a specific entry time and allow time to explore the surrounding Tiananmen and Jingshan Park.
places.address: 4 Jingshan Front St, Dongcheng, Beijing, China

places.name: Tiananmen Square
places.ai_summary: One of the largest public squares in the world, Tiananmen Square is a civic and historic focal point surrounded by monuments and government buildings.

opening_hours.notes: Security checks may cause delays.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Forbidden City and the National Museum of China.

attribution.author: AlgaeGraphix
attribution.description: Simplified version of the Beijing Subway logo

places.name: Summer Palace
places.ai_summary: A vast imperial garden centered on Kunming Lake and Longevity Hill, the Summer Palace blends landscaping with historic pavilions and halls.

opening_hours.notes: Boat rides and guided garden tours available seasonally.

places.place_tip: Walk the Long Corridor and take a boat ride on Kunming Lake.

attribution.title: 20090530 Beijing Summer Palace 8638
attribution.author: Jakub Hałun
attribution.description: The painting on the wall of one of the pavilions of the Summer Palace in Beijing

places.name: Temple of Heaven
places.ai_summary: An example of Ming dynasty ceremonial architecture set in a large park, the Temple of Heaven was used by emperors for annual prayer rituals.

opening_hours.notes: Park area is open early for local exercise groups.

places.place_tip: Visit early to see locals practicing tai chi and to avoid crowds.

places.name: Beihai Park
places.ai_summary: A historic imperial garden with a large lake, Beihai Park is a peaceful green space near central Beijing with temples and historic structures.

opening_hours.notes: Boat rentals available on the lake.

places.place_tip: Combine with a walk to Jingshan Park for city views.

places.name: Jingshan Park
places.ai_summary: Located immediately north of the Forbidden City, Jingshan Park’s hilltop provides one of the best panoramic views of central Beijing.

opening_hours.notes: Great for sunrise views over the Forbidden City.

places.place_tip: Climb early for unobstructed views of the Forbidden City and skyline.

places.name: 798 Art District
places.ai_summary: A contemporary art zone housed in converted industrial factories, 798 is Beijing’s creative hub with galleries, cafes and boutiques.
places.cost: Free to enter galleries (some exhibits paid)

opening_hours.notes: Hours vary by gallery; many cafes open late.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and leave time to explore side galleries and cafes.
places.address: Dashanzi Art District, Chaoyang, Beijing, China

attribution.title: 798ArtZone2009

attribution.description: Patrons stroll through the 798 Art Zone, Beijing, late on a Sunday evening in April 2009.

places.name: National Museum of China
places.ai_summary: One of the largest museums in the world, focusing on Chinese history and art, located on the eastern side of Tiananmen Square.

opening_hours.notes: Online reservation often required for special exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Check the rotating exhibitions and reserve tickets in advance if needed.
places.address: 16 E Chang'an Ave, Dongcheng, Beijing, China

places.name: Wangfujing Street
places.ai_summary: A major shopping street known for malls, boutiques and a popular night market featuring Chinese street food specialties.

opening_hours.notes: Night market opens in the evening; be mindful of crowds.

places.place_tip: Try local snacks at the night market but be cautious if you have dietary restrictions.

places.name: Hutongs of Beijing (Nanluoguxiang)
places.ai_summary: Nanluoguxiang is a charming lane within Beijing's traditional hutongs, lined with shops, cafes, and preserved courtyard homes.

opening_hours.notes: Small shops open mostly in the afternoon.

places.place_tip: Explore side alleys for quieter, more authentic scenes and small teahouses.

places.name: Lama Temple (Yonghe Temple)
places.ai_summary: A well-preserved Tibetan Buddhist monastery known for its ornate architecture and large Buddha statues.

opening_hours.notes: Respectful attire required; photography may be restricted inside halls.

places.place_tip: Observe prayer rituals quietly and avoid flash photography.

places.name: Olympic Park & Bird’s Nest Stadium
places.ai_summary: The 2008 Olympic Park features iconic stadium architecture like the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube, plus large public spaces and museums.

opening_hours.notes: Events may change opening times.

places.place_tip: Check event schedules and book stadium tours ahead of time.

attribution.title: Beijing China Beijing-National-Stadium-01
attribution.author: CEphoto, Uwe Aranas
attribution.description: Beijing, China: National Stadium, also known als "birds nest"

places.name: Beijing Zoo & Panda House
places.ai_summary: Home to a wide range of animals including giant pandas, the Beijing Zoo is a family-friendly attraction with botanical displays.

opening_hours.notes: Panda viewing times can be busy; arrive early.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby Beijing Aquarium if interested.
places.address: No.137 Xizhimenwai Street, Xicheng, Beijing, China

places.name: Panjiayuan Antique Market
places.ai_summary: A sprawling weekend market specializing in antiques, crafts and collectibles — a favorite for treasure hunters and photographers.

opening_hours.notes: Most lively on weekends; bargain respectfully.

places.place_tip: Bring cash for small purchases and be ready to haggle politely.

places.name: Houhai Lake
places.ai_summary: A popular nightlife and dining area around interconnected lakes with hutongs, bars and boat rides.

opening_hours.notes: Evening is liveliest for bars and restaurants.

places.place_tip: Stroll the lakeside and try local restaurants; boat rides are scenic at dusk.

attribution.description: Strolling along the houhai lake in Beijing

places.name: Prince Gong Mansion
places.ai_summary: A well-preserved Qing dynasty mansion offering gardens, courtyards and exhibitions on aristocratic life in imperial Beijing.

opening_hours.notes: Quiet, historically rich site near the Houhai area.

places.place_tip: Pair with a walk through nearby hutongs for a full historic experience.
places.address: No.17 Qianhai East St, Xicheng, Beijing, China

places.name: Capital Museum
places.ai_summary: A modern museum dedicated to the history and culture of Beijing and the surrounding region with rotating exhibitions.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on some national holidays.

places.place_tip: Good alternative to the busier national museum for local history exhibitions.

places.name: Zhongshan Park
places.ai_summary: A compact, well-kept park with historic pavilions close to the Forbidden City, popular for strolls and local gatherings.

opening_hours.notes: Small park — pair with Forbidden City visit.

places.place_tip: Enter from the east gate to reach pavilion viewpoints quickly.

places.name: Beijing Botanical Garden
places.ai_summary: Large botanical gardens featuring themed plant collections, greenhouses and seasonal flower displays on the western edge of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Best in spring when flowers are in bloom.

places.place_tip: Check the greenhouse schedules for special exhibits.
